exposure: Posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSS) after childbirth (IES-R scores)
Family Adaptation, Partnership, Growth, Affection, and Resolve (F.APGAR) scores
outcome: mother-infant bonding failure (Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire - PBQ scores)
cohort: 130 mothers in Japan surveyed at 1 month and 4 months after delivery.
finding: Posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSS) after childbirth significantly influenced bonding failure at 1 month postpartum, but at 4 months postpartum, depression was identified as the more critical factor affecting bonding failure.
